sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，在加利福尼亚州的一处葡萄园内发现了一具女尸。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首，体内的血也被抽干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 看来凶手费尽心机来隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，人们只知道她叫无名氏。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 接着，侦探们终于查到了她的名字叫阿达。

sentences.en: But identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但知道了她的身份，却让这起离奇的谋杀案更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《阿达》是“档案档案呈献”推出的全新系列，各大播客平台现已上线。

sentences.en: Today's episode involves crimes against children, and won't be suitable for all listeners.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目涉及针对儿童的犯罪，并非适合所有听众。

sentences.en: Spirits were high for the Balmain women's water polo team on the night of Saturday March 18, 1995.
sentences.zh: 1995年3月18日星期六晚，巴尔曼女子水球队士气高昂。

sentences.en: Despite losing against their rival team during the club's grand final a few hours earlier,
sentences.zh: 尽管几个小时前在该俱乐部的总决赛中输给了竞争对手，

sentences.en: the players and their supporters were celebrating the end of an otherwise successful season with drinks at a Balmain pub.
sentences.zh: 但队员和支持者们仍在巴尔曼的一家酒吧喝酒，庆祝这个原本算得上成功的赛季结束。

sentences.en: 19-year-old Kelly Lane was among them, having played a solid game.
sentences.zh: 19岁的凯利·莱恩也在其中，她在比赛中表现稳健。

sentences.en: Her parents had watched the match, but they couldn't stick around for drinks.
sentences.zh: 她的父母观看了比赛，但无法留下来喝酒。

sentences.en: Instead, Kelly was joined by her boyfriend Duncan Gillies and his mother Julie, who had also attended the game.
sentences.zh: 取而代之的是，凯利的男友邓肯·吉利斯和他的母亲朱莉陪着凯利，他们也观看了这场比赛。

sentences.en: At around 9pm, a few of Kelly's teammates noticed that Kelly had left without saying a word.
sentences.zh: 晚上9点左右，凯利的几个队友发现凯利一声不吭地离开了。

sentences.en: Duncan and Julie were still there, so her teammates didn't give it too much thought and continued on with their night.
sentences.zh: 邓肯和朱莉还在那里，所以队友们没有多想，继续享受他们的夜晚。

sentences.en: Little did any of them know, while playing an impressive grand final in front of a crowd filled with her loved ones,
sentences.zh: 他们谁也没想到，在满场亲友的注视下打出一场精彩的总决赛时，

sentences.en: Kelly had been keeping a huge secret.
sentences.zh: 凯利一直保守着一个巨大的秘密。

sentences.en: She was nine months pregnant.
sentences.zh: 她已经怀孕九个月了。

sentences.en: The reason she'd left the pub was because she'd gone into labour.
sentences.zh: 她离开酒吧的原因是她临产了。

sentences.en: Kelly took a taxi alone to the Balmain hospital about a kilometre away and was subsequently transferred to King George V Memorial Hospital,
sentences.zh: 凯利独自乘出租车前往大约一公里外的巴尔曼医院，随后被转往乔治五世国王纪念医院，

sentences.en: where she gave birth to her first child, Kayla, the following morning.
sentences.zh: 并在第二天早上在那里生下了她的第一个孩子开拉。

sentences.en: Staff took pity on the polite and warm-natured 19-year-old.
sentences.zh: 医护人员对这位彬彬有礼、性格温和的19岁女孩心生怜悯。

sentences.en: Not only was it incredibly rare for a young woman to give birth alone and without a single visitor,
sentences.zh: 年轻女子独自产子且没有一个访客的情况本就极其罕见，

sentences.en: in the hours following the delivery, it was clear that Kelly was incredibly upset.
sentences.zh: 而在分娩后的几个小时里，很明显凯利情绪非常低落。

sentences.en: A social worker was assigned to make sure she was okay.
sentences.zh: 医院指派了一名社工来确保她安然无恙。

sentences.en: Kelly explained that she and the baby's father, Duncan Gillies, had only recently moved to Sydney from their hometown of Perth, which was why she had no support.
sentences.zh: 凯利解释说，她和孩子的父亲邓肯·吉利斯不久前刚从他们的家乡珀斯搬到悉尼，这就是她没有旁人支持的原因。

sentences.en: Duncan was furthering his rugby career while Kelly was training to play water polo for Australia at the 2000 Olympics.
sentences.zh: 邓肯在发展他的橄榄球事业，而凯利则在接受训练，准备代表澳大利亚参加2000年奥运会的水球比赛。

sentences.en: It was the first time that women's water polo would feature at the event and she hoped to make the team.
sentences.zh: 这是女子水球首次被列为奥运会比赛项目，她希望能入选国家队。

sentences.en: Unable to care for a child and not wanting to have an abortion, Kelly said the couple had agreed to place Kayla for adoption.
sentences.zh: 由于无力抚养孩子又不想堕胎，凯利称两人已经同意将开拉送养。

sentences.en: On the evening of Tuesday, March 21, 1995, Kelly requested a pass-out so she could discuss the adoption with Duncan in private.
sentences.zh: 1995年3月21日星期二晚上，凯利申请了外出许可，以便私下与邓肯讨论收养事宜。

sentences.en: Hospital staff granted the request, taking care of baby Kayla so Kelly could get her affairs in order.
sentences.zh: 医院工作人员批准了这一请求，并照顾婴儿开拉，好让凯利去处理好她的事情。

sentences.en: Kelly returned in the early morning hours, saying Duncan didn't want to be involved in the adoption process.
sentences.zh: 凯利于清晨返回，称邓肯不想参与收养过程。

sentences.en: As per protocol, the adoption agency still tried multiple times to contact Duncan using the details Kelly provided.
sentences.zh: 按照惯例，收养机构仍然多次尝试使用凯利提供的信息联系邓肯。

sentences.en: All attempts were unsuccessful.
sentences.zh: 所有尝试都失败了。

sentences.en: Kelly explained that Duncan was purposely avoiding them because she'd promised him he didn't need to be involved.
sentences.zh: 凯利解释说，邓肯是在故意躲着他们，因为她曾向他保证他不需要参与。

sentences.en: Besides, he was about to go overseas to play rugby and would be unreachable for the next two weeks.
sentences.zh: 除此之外，他即将出国打橄榄球，在接下来的两周内将无法联系到。

sentences.en: Eventually, after weeks of trying to contact Duncan Gillies without success,
sentences.zh: 最终，在数周联系不上邓肯·吉利斯之后，

sentences.en: the adoption agency had Kelly sign an affidavit confirming Duncan was Kayla's father and had consented to the adoption.
sentences.zh: 收养机构让凯利签署了一份宣誓书，确认邓肯是开拉的父亲并同意收养。

sentences.en: She signed a second affidavit a few weeks later, saying Duncan had ended their relationship and wanted nothing to do with their child or the adoption.
sentences.zh: 几周后她签署了第二份宣誓书，称邓肯已经结束了他们的关系，不想与他们的孩子或收养有任何瓜葛。

sentences.en: Just months after giving birth, Kelly went on to represent Australia at a water polo tournament in Canada.
sentences.zh: 就在生下孩子几个月后，凯利代表澳大利亚参加了在加拿大举办的水球锦标赛。

sentences.en: Six months later, while Kayla's adoption was still being finalised, Kelly was pregnant again.
sentences.zh: 六个月后，在开拉的收养程序仍在敲定之时，凯利又怀孕了。

sentences.en: After the 2006 coronial inquest into Teagan Lane's whereabouts, her case was officially handed over to the NSW Homicide Squad to be reinvestigated from scratch.
sentences.zh: 在2006年对蒂根·莱恩下落的死因研讯之后，她的案件被正式移交给新南威尔士州凶杀案调查组进行从头到尾的重新调查。

sentences.en: Detectives reviewed all the evidence uncovered so far and undertook their own searches for Teagan Lane and Andrew Norris.
sentences.zh: 侦探们审查了迄今为止发现的所有证据，并自行对蒂根·莱恩和安德鲁·诺里斯展开了搜寻。

sentences.en: They double-checked nationwide records from registry offices, the Immigration Department, Australia Post, missing persons reports, and utility companies.
sentences.zh: 他们仔细核对了来自户籍办公室、移民局、澳大利亚邮政、失踪人员报告和公用事业公司的全国各地记录。

sentences.en: Every possible spelling variation of Teagan was considered.
sentences.zh: 考虑了蒂根名字的所有可能拼写变体。

sentences.en: Checks were made for any Teagans born in 1996 with the connection to a woman named Mel or any variation of that, such as Melanie or Melissa.
sentences.zh: 他们对1996年出生的、与名叫梅尔或其变体（如梅兰妮或梅丽莎）的女性有关联的任何蒂根进行了核查。

sentences.en: But after two years of intense scrutiny, detectives uncovered nothing.
sentences.zh: 但在经过两年的严格审查后，侦探们什么也没有发现。

sentences.en: Although Kelly had been caught in countless lies when it came to Teagan's birth, there was one detail in her story that remained unchanged.
sentences.zh: 尽管凯利在蒂根出生的问题上谎话连篇，但她故事中的一个细节始终没有变。

sentences.en: In each version, she maintained that after being discharged from Auburn Hospital on Saturday September 14, 1996, she went back to Duncan Gilley's house in Gladesville.
sentences.zh: 在每一个版本中，她都坚称在1996年9月14日星期六从奥本医院出院后，她回到了邓肯·吉利斯在格莱兹维尔的家。

sentences.en: Although detectives conducted a cursory search of the property during the missing person investigation in 2003, the Homicide Squad decided it was worth taking a closer look.
sentences.zh: 尽管侦探们在2003年的失踪人口调查期间对该物业进行了粗略搜查，但凶杀案调查组认为有必要进行更仔细的调查。

sentences.en: In early August 2008, Duncan's former property was cordoned off as an extensive search commenced.
sentences.zh: 2008年8月上旬，邓肯以前的房产被拉起警戒线，并开始了广泛的搜查。

sentences.en: The weatherboard home had undergone significant renovations a couple of years prior, yet police remained hopeful they might uncover something of intereSt.
sentences.zh: 这栋木板房在前几年经历过重大翻修，但警方仍然抱有希望，希望能发现一些有趣的东西。

sentences.en: Over five days, they scoured the property with cadaver dogs, checking the yard, the roof, and inside the walls,
sentences.zh: 在五天的时间里，他们带着搜尸犬搜查了这处房产，检查了院子、屋顶和墙壁内部，

sentences.en: while a forensic anthropologist sifted through the soil underneath the house.
sentences.zh: 同时法医人类学家在房屋底下的土壤中过筛寻找。

sentences.en: They identified several small bone fragments which were sent away for further testing.
sentences.zh: 他们发现了几处送去进一步化验的小块骨头碎片。

sentences.en: By this point, Teagan Lane's case had been in the hands of police for more than eight and a half years, and in the public spotlight for three.
sentences.zh: 到这时，蒂根·莱恩的案子已经在警方手中超过了八年半，并在公众聚光灯下三年。

sentences.en: In all that time, investigators failed to uncover a single piece of evidence indicating what had happened to Teagan.
sentences.zh: 在所有这些时间里，调查人员未能发现任何表明蒂根遭遇了什么的证据。

sentences.en: Police had been keeping a close eye on Kelly, with another covert tap placed on her phone.
sentences.zh: 警方一直在密切监视凯利，并在她的电话上安装了另一个秘密窃听器。

sentences.en: While Kelly said nothing incriminating during any of these calls, there was something about them that investigators found significant.
sentences.zh: 虽然凯利在这些通话中没有说任何 incriminating（自我定罪）的话，但调查人员发现这些通话有些不同寻常之处。

sentences.en: At no point did Kelly Lane make her own attempts to find her missing daughter.
sentences.zh: 凯利·莱恩在任何时候都没有试图寻找她失踪的女儿。

sentences.en: It was something they denoted early in the investigation.
sentences.zh: 这是他们在调查早期就注意到的事情。

sentences.en: If Kelly's story about giving Teagan to Andrew Norris was true, and she'd so desperately wanted to keep the whole ordeal a secret from her family and friends,
sentences.zh: 如果凯利关于把蒂根交给安德鲁·诺里斯的故事是真的，并且她如此拼命地想要把整个磨难对家人和朋友保密，

sentences.en: then why hadn't she tried to find the pair herself?
sentences.zh: 那么她为什么不自己试着去找这两个人呢？

sentences.en: Kelly initially claimed to have old diaries that might have outdated contact details for Andrew and some mutual friends, yet she never attempted to track these down.
sentences.zh: 凯利最初声称有旧日记，里面可能有安德鲁和一些共同朋友的过时联系方式，但她从未试图去追踪这些。

sentences.en: One journalist discovered that in 2003, Kelly visited a website that aimed to reconnect long-lost school friends.
sentences.zh: 一名记者发现，2003年，凯利访问了一个旨在重新联系失散多年的校友的网站。

sentences.en: She posted a brief message which read,
sentences.zh: 她发布了一条简短的信息，上面写着，

sentences.en: She shared a similar message shortly after, adding that the Andrew Norris she was looking for had a partner named Melanie,
sentences.zh: 不久之后她分享了一条类似的信息，补充说她正在寻找的安德鲁·诺里斯有一个名叫梅兰妮的伴侣，

sentences.en: While this wasn't an indicator of guilt, it led some to believe that Kelly wasn't trying to track Teagan down because she already knew Teagan was dead.
sentences.zh: 虽然这并不是有罪的指标，但这让一些人认为凯利没有试图追踪蒂根，是因为她已经知道蒂根死了。

sentences.en: But, like everything else in the case, this was just an unsubstantiated theory.
sentences.zh: 但是，就像案子里的其他一切一样，这只是一种没有根据的理论。

sentences.en: After two years of investigations, the homicide squad still had no concrete evidence tying Kelly to Teagan's death, but they remained convinced she had killed the newborn.
sentences.zh: 经过两年的调查，凶杀案调查组仍然没有确凿的证据将凯利与蒂根的死联系起来，但他们仍然坚信她杀死了这个新生儿。

sentences.en: The fact of the matter was, there was nothing to suggest anyone had ever seen Teagan Lane after she and Kelly were discharged from Auburn Hospital at around midday on Saturday,
sentences.zh: 事实是，没有任何迹象表明有人在周六中午左右凯利和蒂根从奥本医院出院后见过蒂根·莱恩，

sentences.en: September 14, 1996.
By 3pm, Kelly was at her parents' house in Fairlight, with no baby in sight.
sentences.zh: 到下午3点，凯利已经在她位于费尔莱特的父母家中，不见孩子的踪影。

sentences.en: If it took around an hour to make the drive, then what was Kelly doing during the unaccounted-for, two-hour window?
sentences.zh: 如果开车需要大约一个小时，那么凯利在这无法解释的两小时窗口期里在做什麽？

sentences.en: Based on the evidence at hand, investigators started to piece together what they believed to be a likely scenario.
sentences.zh: 根据手头的证据，调查人员开始拼凑出他们认为最可能发生的情景。

sentences.en: By the time 21-year-old Kelly was nearing the end of her pregnancy with Teagan,
sentences.zh: 当21岁的凯利接近蒂根的预产期时，

sentences.en: she was no longer the naive, first-time mother she'd been when Kayla was born almost 18 months earlier.
sentences.zh: 她已经不再是18个月前生下开拉时那个天真的初为人母的女孩了。

sentences.en: As she'd learnt from her experience at the Balmain pub, labour could occur at any time.
sentences.zh: 正如她在巴尔曼酒吧的经历中所学到的那样，分娩随时可能发生。

sentences.en: Knowing she was expected to attend the wedding of Duncan's family friends on Saturday, September 14, 1996,
sentences.zh: 由于知道自己必须出席1996年9月14日星期六邓肯家族朋友的婚礼，

sentences.en: she couldn't risk going into labour in front of the other guests or at any other awkward moment.
sentences.zh: 她不能冒在其他宾客面前或在任何其他尴尬时刻临产的风险。

sentences.en: Time was of the essence.
sentences.zh: 时间紧迫。

sentences.en: In early September, Duncan was out of town on a rugby trip, giving Kelly an ample window of opportunity to give birth without those close to her finding out.
sentences.zh: 9月初，邓肯出城进行橄榄球旅行，这为凯利提供了充足的机会窗口，让她在亲近的人不知情的情况下分娩。

sentences.en: Medical records showed she visited Wright Hospital on Saturday, September 7, Monday, September 9, and then again on Tuesday, September 10.
sentences.zh: 医疗记录显示，她在9月7日星期六、9月9日星期一以及9月10日星期二再次访问了赖特医院。

sentences.en: Each time, she claimed her baby was overdue, which had derailed her plan of a home birth with her private midwife.
sentences.zh: 每次她都声称她的孩子过期妊娠，这打破了她与私人助产士在家分娩的计划。

sentences.en: And each time, she sought to have an induction.
sentences.zh: 并且每次她都要求催产。

sentences.en: Without any antenatal records to prove the baby's gestation, hospital staff denied each of her requests.
sentences.zh: 在没有任何产前记录来证明胎儿孕龄的情况下，医院工作人员拒绝了她的每一项请求。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, September 11, 1996, Kelly went to Auburn Hospital on the other side of town, giving the same story she'd given at Wright.
sentences.zh: 1996年9月11日星期三，凯利去了城另一边的奥本医院，讲述了她在赖特医院讲过同样的遭遇。

sentences.en: There, her request to be induced was granted.
sentences.zh: 在那里，她催产的请求得到了批准。

sentences.en: Tegan was born on Thursday, September 12.
sentences.zh: 蒂根于9月12日星期四出生。

sentences.en: Investigators believed it was at this point that Kelly started to panic.
sentences.zh: 调查人员认为正是在这个时候凯利开始惊慌失措。

sentences.en: The unexpected complications with her retained placenta meant she required post-op care and she'd be pushing it to be discharged in time to attend the wedding on Saturday.
sentences.zh: 胎盘残留带来的意外并发症意味着她需要术后护理，要想赶在周六及时出院参加婚礼将会十分勉强。

sentences.en: Knowing she couldn't take Tegan home, but unwilling to go through what she now knew to be a lengthy, complicated, and emotionally gruelling adoption process,
sentences.zh: 由于知道自己不能把蒂根带回家，又不愿经历她现在所知道的漫长、复杂且在情感上令人筋疲力尽的收养程序，

sentences.en: Kelly lied to hospital staff and said she'd be receiving at-home care from her private midwife.
sentences.zh: 凯利对医院工作人员撒谎说她将接受私人助产士的居家护理。

sentences.en: On Saturday, September 14, she was granted permission to leave as long as she completed some paperwork, including the Guthrie Test consent form
sentences.zh: 9月14日星期六，她被批准离开，只要她完成一些文书工作，包括 Guthrie 测试同意书

sentences.en: and the registration form to submit to the Registry of Births, Deaths and Marriages.
sentences.zh: 以及提交给出生、死亡和结婚登记处的登记表。

sentences.en: An appointment was also made for a midwife to visit her at home in a few days' time.
sentences.zh: 还预约了一名助产士在几天后去她家拜访。

sentences.en: With just hours to spare before the wedding, Kelly left at around midday without completing any of the paperwork or signing the discharge papers.
sentences.zh: 在距离婚礼仅剩数小时之际，凯利在大约中午时分离开，没有完成任何文书工作或签署出院文件。

sentences.en: No hospital staff or the other patient Kelly was sharing a room with recalled seeing Kelly and Tegan leave that day.
sentences.zh: 没有医护人员或与凯利同住一间病房的另一名病人回忆起那天看到凯利和蒂根离开。

sentences.en: However, there was an unalarmed fire escape directly opposite their room, which Kelly could have exited from without passing the nurse's station.
sentences.zh: 然而，她们病房正对面有一个没有报警装置的安全通道，凯利可以从那里离开而不经过护士站。

sentences.en: There was no CCTV footage to prove what happened after Kelly left the hospital, but she claimed that was when she met up with Andrew Norris,
sentences.zh: 没有闭路电视录像来证明凯利离开医院后发生了什么，但她声称那是她与安德鲁·诺里斯、

sentences.en: Andrew's mother, and his partner Mel, to hand Tegan over.
sentences.zh: 安德鲁的母亲以及他的伴侣梅尔会面以移交蒂根的时候。

sentences.en: Kelly initially claimed to have taken a taxi home, but later said she'd driven herself.
sentences.zh: 凯利最初声称坐出租车回家，但后来改口说她是自己开的车。

sentences.en: Homicide detectives ran checks with every taxi company in Sydney and found no records of any passengers being picked up from Auburn Hospital on Saturday, September 14, 1996.
sentences.zh: 凶杀案侦探与悉尼的所有出租车公司进行了核查，发现没有记录显示在1996年9月14日星期六有任何乘客从奥本医院被接走。

sentences.zh: 信中写道：“亲爱的梅尔德拉姆-汉纳女士：

sentences.en: My name is Kelly Lane, and I have been wrongfully convicted of murdering my baby in 1996.

sentences.en: I believe if the public knew the real facts, had all the information, and saw the errors and questions that still remain in
sentences.zh: 我相信，如果公众了解真实的事实，掌握所有的信息，并看到我的案子中

sentences.zh: 归根结底，我们正试图寻找安德鲁、我们的女儿或某位家庭成员。”

sentences.en: Caro wasn't sure what to make of the letter.
sentences.zh: 卡罗不知道该如何看待这封信。

sentences.en: She was well known for her work on the ABC's popular current affairs program, Four Corners, but she'd never covered Tegan Lane's case
sentences.zh: 她因在澳大利亚广播公司广受欢迎的时事节目《四角》中的工作而闻名，但她从未报道过蒂根·莱恩的案子

sentences.en: before, so her first thought was that the letter must be a prank.
sentences.zh: ，所以她的第一反应是这封信一定是个恶作剧。

sentences.en: Caro contacted Kelly in prison and confirmed the letter was legitimate.
sentences.zh: 卡罗在监狱里联系了凯莉，并证实这封信是真的。

sentences.en: When asked if there was any way she could have harmed Tegan, Kelly responded firmly,
sentences.zh: 当被问及她是否有任何可能伤害蒂根时，凯莉坚定地回答：

sentences.en: There is no way.
sentences.zh: 绝不可能。

sentences.en: There is no way.
sentences.zh: 绝不可能。

sentences.en: If Andrew didn't turn up, I would have just left her there, or I would have gone down the exact same path as before, I would have asked for some help, I would
sentences.zh: 如果安德鲁没有出现，我本就会把她留在那里，或者我会走上和以前完全一样的路，我会寻求一些帮助，我会

sentences.zh: 要求去见一家领养机构，而且我会做和 18 个月前完全一样的事情。

sentences.en: I remember that day, clear as.
sentences.zh: 我记得那个日子，记得清清楚楚。

sentences.en: I know a lot of people think I'm cold and callous, but those children were very important to me and I loved them.
sentences.zh: 我知道很多人觉得我冷酷无情，但那些孩子对我很重要，我很爱他们。

sentences.en: I thought I was doing the right thing by them.
sentences.zh: 我以为我是在为他们做正确的事。

sentences.en: Caro agreed to make a documentary about the case, which would be titled, Exposed, The
sentences.zh: 卡罗同意拍摄一部关于此案的纪录片，片名暂定为《揭秘：凯莉·莱恩案》

sentences.en: Case of Kelly Lane, but only under the condition that no topic was off limits and she would follow the truth wherever it led.
sentences.zh: ，但前提是没有任何禁忌话题，她将追寻真相，无论真相指向何方。

sentences.en: Kelly agreed, and in turn, she handed over her entire case file and court records, including private correspondence sent between herself and her defence team.
sentences.zh: 凯莉表示同意，随后她交出了她整个案卷和法庭记录，包括她与辩护团队之间的私人信件。

sentences.en: Caro and a small team fully immersed themselves in the case.
sentences.zh: 卡罗和一个小团队全身心地投入到这个案子中。

sentences.en: They tracked down and interviewed anyone and everyone from Kelly's past who was willing to speak with them, including former water polo coaches, teammates, boyfriends, and even her
sentences.zh: 他们追踪并采访了凯莉过去所有愿意与他们对话的人，包括前水球教练、队友、男友，甚至她的

sentences.en: parents.
sentences.zh: 父母。

sentences.en: They spoke to the coroner, prosecutors, and homicide squad detectives who worked on Kelly's case,
sentences.zh: 他们采访了参与凯莉案的验尸官、检察官和凶杀组侦探，

sentences.en: and were handed a USB containing exclusive confidential police files from a secret informant.
sentences.zh: 并收到一个 USB，里面包含来自秘密线人的独家保密警方档案。

sentences.en: After nine months of intense research, the exposed team identified several holes in the investigation
sentences.zh: 经过九个月的深入研究，揭秘团队发现了调查过程中的几个漏洞

sentences.en: as well as questionable legal tactics that had them asking, was Kelly Lane wrongfully convicted?
sentences.zh: 以及可疑的法律策略，这让他们不禁发问：凯莉·莱恩是被冤枉的吗？

sentences.en: During Kelly's trial, police claimed that exhaustive efforts had been made to interview all the
sentences.zh: 在凯莉受审期间，警方声称他们已经做了详尽的努力，采访了威斯贝奇街公寓楼的所有

sentences.en: former tenants of the apartment building on Wisbech Street, where Kelly said Andrew Norris had lived.
sentences.zh: 前租户，凯莉曾说安德鲁·诺里斯在那里住过。

sentences.en: None of the tenants recalled ever seeing Kelly there, nor did they have any knowledge of a resident called Andrew Norris.
sentences.zh: 没有一个租户记得曾在那里见过凯莉，也没有人知道有一个叫安德鲁·诺里斯的居民。

sentences.en: One former tenant did testify to seeing mail addressed to Andrew Norris, as well as Andrew
sentences.zh: 确实有一位前租户作证说看到过寄给安德鲁·诺里斯以及安德鲁

sentences.en: Morris, but his claims were discounted as he'd given various inconsistent statements over the years.
sentences.zh: 莫里斯的信件，但他的说法被否定了，因为他在过去几年里给出了各种不一致的陈述。

sentences.en: However, the exposed team discovered that there was at least one tenant who had never been questioned, a man named Daryl Hanson.
sentences.zh: 然而，揭秘团队发现至少有一名租户从未被讯问过，这个人叫达里尔·汉森。

sentences.en: The team tracked Daryl down on Facebook and organised a video meeting.
sentences.zh: 团队在脸书上找到了达里尔，并安排了一场视频会议。

sentences.en: When Caro Meldrum Hanna showed Daryl a photo of Kelly Lane taken in about 1996, he claimed he remembered seeing her around the building.
sentences.zh: 当卡罗·梅尔德拉姆·汉纳向达里尔展示了一张凯莉·莱恩大约 1996 年拍摄的照片时，他声称自己记得在楼里见过她。

sentences.en: Daryl said he used to spend a lot of time in the downstairs car park, working on his car late at night.
sentences.zh: 达里尔说他过去经常花很多时间在楼下的停车场，深夜在那里修车。

sentences.en: He remembered seeing Kelly exit the building through the car park several times, sometimes as late as 1am.
sentences.zh: 他记得曾多次看到凯莉穿过停车场离开大楼，有时甚至晚到凌晨 1 点。

sentences.en: Daryl claimed he saw Kelly so many times that he thought she must have lived in the building.
sentences.zh: 达里尔声称他看到凯莉的次数实在太多，以至于他认为她肯定住在楼里。

sentences.en: When pressed by Caro as to whether he could be misremembering in hindsight, Daryl insisted
sentences.zh: 当卡罗追问他事后是否记错了时，达里尔坚称

sentences.en: Kelly Lane was the person he had seen.
sentences.zh: 凯莉·莱恩就是他见过的那个人。

sentences.en: He was so sure that he said he'd happily testify that in a court of law.
sentences.zh: 他如此确信，以至于他说他很乐意在法庭上为此作证。

sentences.en: The exposed team also interviewed a childhood friend of Kelly's named Natalie McCauley, who had recently appeared on 60 Minutes in Kelly's defence.
sentences.zh: 揭秘团队还采访了凯莉的一位童年好友娜塔莉·麦考利，她最近曾在《60分钟》节目中为凯莉辩护。

sentences.en: Natalie claimed that she remembered the summer of 1996 very clearly, as it was the year that she and all her friends had turned 21.
sentences.zh: 娜塔莉声称她对 1996 年的夏天记忆犹新，因为那是她和所有朋友满 21 岁的一年。

sentences.en: Early in the year, Kelly allegedly confided in Natalie that she was having a fling with another man.
sentences.zh: 据称在年初时，凯莉曾向娜塔莉吐露，她正与另一个男人有一段风流韵事。

sentences.en: She mentioned it at least three times over a one-month period.
sentences.zh: 在一个月的时间里，她至少提到了三次。

sentences.en: Natalie said she remembered the name of Kelly's secret lover clearly, as he had the same first name as Natalie's brother, Andrew.
sentences.zh: 娜塔莉说她清楚地记得凯莉秘密情人的名字，因为他的名字和娜塔莉的弟弟安德鲁同名。

sentences.en: Natalie claimed that she'd provided police with this information during the investigation and she'd also been willing to testify in Kelly's defence at trial.
sentences.zh: 娜塔莉声称她在调查期间向警方提供过这些信息，并且她也愿意在审判中为凯莉无罪辩护。

sentences.en: However, she believed the police weren't interested because they were already convinced of Kelly's guilt.
sentences.zh: 然而，她认为警方对此不感兴趣，因为他们已经坚信凯莉有罪。

sentences.en: Adamant that she wouldn't lie about such a thing, especially given her profession in child protection, Natalie told Exposed, I am passionate about children's rights.
sentences.zh: 娜塔莉坚称自己不会为这种事撒谎，考虑到她的儿童保护职业更是如此，她对《揭秘》节目说：我对儿童权利充满热情。

sentences.en: I love children.
sentences.zh: 我热爱儿童。

sentences.en: Every day, my waking hour is about protecting kids.
sentences.zh: 我每天醒着的每一刻都与保护孩子有关。

sentences.en: I'm not about to let my friend get off easy if she's hurt a child.
sentences.zh: 如果我朋友伤害了孩子，我是绝不会让她轻易脱罪的。

sentences.en: During the search for Tegan's father, police had also spoken to a man named Andrew Morris who
sentences.zh: 在寻找蒂根生父的过程中，警方还曾找过一个叫安德鲁·莫里斯的男人，

sentences.zh: 他回忆说在 20 世纪 90 年代中期曾因参加冲浪救生比赛而访问过悉尼北部海滩。

sentences.en: When shown a photo line-up of several young women, Andrew Morris recognised Kelly Lane but couldn't be sure how or why.
sentences.zh: 当被出示几名年轻女性的照片阵容时，安德鲁·莫里斯认出了凯莉·莱恩，但不能确定是如何认出的或为什么认出。

sentences.en: He told the exposed team that the police then began drip-feeding him information about Kelly
sentences.zh: 他告诉揭秘团队，警方随后开始向他一点点透露关于凯莉的信息，

sentences.en: until he put two and two together and realised that they once had a random one-off sexual encounter at the North Narrabeen Surf Club.
sentences.zh: 直到他把线索串联起来，意识到他们曾经在北纳拉宾冲浪俱乐部有过一次偶然的露水情缘。

sentences.en: It had happened around the same time that Tegan would have been conceived.
sentences.zh: 那大约发生在蒂根可能被孕育的同一时期。

sentences.en: Andrew had been scheduled to testify for the prosecution at Kelly's trial, not to suggest he was Tegan's father, but to explain how Kelly came up with the Andrew
sentences.zh: 安德鲁原本被安排在凯莉的审判中为控方作证，倒不是说他是蒂根的父亲，而是为了解释凯莉是如何构思出安德鲁

sentences.en: Morris or Norris persona in the first place.
sentences.zh: 莫里斯或诺里斯这个假身份的。

sentences.en: Then, at the last minute, a deal was made between both legal teaMs.
sentences.zh: 然后，在最后一分钟，控辩双方达成了一项交易。

sentences.en: Andrew wouldn't testify, and neither would Natalie McCauley.
sentences.zh: 安德鲁不会出庭作证，娜塔莉·麦考利也不会。

sentences.en: This was just one of several factors that led Kelly's case to being taken on by the Bridge
sentences.zh: 这只是导致凯莉的案子被“希望之桥”无罪倡议组织接手的几个因素之一，该组织致力于调查可能的冤假错案。

sentences.en: of Hope Innocence Initiative, an organisation dedicated to examining possible wrongful convictions.
sentences.zh: 希望清白倡议组织，一个致力于调查可能的冤假错案的机构。

sentences.en: For Kelly's supporters, these allegations of witness coaching, witness swapping, and deals struck between the prosecution and defence were further evidence that Kelly hadn't

sentences.en: received a fair trial.
sentences.zh: 得到公正的审判。

sentences.en: If the hospital records were correct, and Kelly really had left the hospital at 2pm and was
sentences.zh: 如果医院记录是正确的，凯莉真的在下午 2 点离开医院，并且

sentences.zh: 在下午 3 点天色尚明时回到家中，那么《揭秘》推测凯莉将没有时间杀死蒂根并处理她的尸体。

sentences.en: Even investigators who worked on the case were critical of the way things were handled.
sentences.zh: 甚至连参与此案的调查人员也对处理案件的方式提出了批评。

sentences.en: Various individuals involved expressed their discomfort with Kelly's conviction.
sentences.zh: 多名相关人员对凯莉的定罪表示了不安。

sentences.en: The detective who led the investigation into Tegan's murder had since retired from the force.
sentences.zh: 负责调查蒂根谋杀案的领头女侦探此后已经从警队退休。

sentences.en: She told exposed that police had no evidence against Kelly and weren't ready when the DPP decided to proceed with the murder charge.
sentences.zh: 她告诉《揭秘》，警方对凯莉没有任何证据，当刑事检控专员办公室决定以谋杀罪起诉时，他们根本没有准备好。

sentences.en: I used every trick in the book, the former detective explained.
sentences.zh: 我用了书里所有的招数，这位前侦探解释道。

sentences.zh: 卧底策略、秘密 DNA 样本、所有可用的资源。

sentences.en: Tegan's biological father, they never organised for a composite sketch to be made.
sentences.zh: 蒂根的生父进行了大量的挖掘工作，但他们从未组织制作过合成画像。

sentences.en: They questioned why such an image wasn't broadcast around Australia, asking anyone who had seen such a man to come forward.
sentences.zh: 他们质疑为什么这样一张画像没有在全澳大利亚播发，并要求任何见过这样一个男人的人站出来。

sentences.en: The exposed team organised for a former police officer turned forensic artist to visit Kelly in prison.
sentences.zh: 揭秘团队安排了一位前警官转行的法医艺术家去监狱探访凯莉。

sentences.en: Kelly recalled Andrew's physical features in detail and a clear composite sketch of Andrew

sentences.en: Norris was created for the first time.
sentences.zh: 清晰的合成画像。

sentences.en: The forensic artist, who had 18 years' experience creating sketches, believed Kelly was truthful in her description.
sentences.zh: 这位拥有 18 年肖像绘制经验的法医艺术家相信凯莉的描述是真实的。

sentences.en: She was consistent throughout, he said.
sentences.zh: 她自始至终都很一致，他说。

sentences.en: She didn't sway at all.
sentences.zh: 她一点也没有动摇。

sentences.en: In a phone call from prison, Kelly told Caro Meldrum-Hanna that from a very young age her athletic training taught her to hide her emotions.
sentences.zh: 在从监狱打来的电话中，凯莉告诉卡罗·梅尔德拉姆-汉纳，从很小的时候起，她的运动训练就教她如何隐藏自己的情绪。

sentences.en: She was excellent at filing feelings away and being a different person for different people.
sentences.zh: 她极其擅长把情感封存起来，在不同的人面前扮演不同的人。

sentences.en: She also revealed that her first sexual experience was being date-raped while intoxicated at the age of 15.
sentences.zh: 她还透露，她的第一次性经历是她在 15 岁时醉酒被约会强暴。

sentences.en: Kelly explained,
sentences.zh: 凯莉解释说：

sentences.en: I don't think I valued my body and my choices and my boundaries because everybody just seemed to be so frivolous with it.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我不曾珍视自己的身体、选择和底线，因为每个人对这些似乎都太轻率了。

sentences.en: She struggled upon learning that several people in her life had indeed suspected she was pregnant at times but never reached out.
sentences.zh: 得知生活中确实有好几个人有时曾怀疑她怀孕，却从未主动联系过她，凯莉感到十分挣扎。

sentences.en: While Kelly made it clear she didn't want to shift the responsibility onto others, she asked
sentences.zh: 凯莉明确表示她并不想把责任推卸给他人，但她质问

sentences.en: Caro, wasn't I worth asking?
sentences.zh: 卡罗，难道我就不值得别人问一句吗？

sentences.en: Why were people afraid or why did they not want to ask me?
sentences.zh: 为什么大家会害怕，或者为什么他们不想来问我？

sentences.en: It's kind of sad to think that no one reached out and said, you seem different or you look different or are you okay?
sentences.zh: 一想到没有人主动走过来对我说“你看起来有点不一样”或者“你还好吗”，就让人觉得挺悲哀的。

sentences.en: As part of the documentary, Kelly agreed to meet face-to-face with Dr. Anne Buist, a forensic
sentences.zh: 作为纪录片的一部分，凯莉同意与安妮·比斯特博士（Dr. Anne Buist）进行面对面会谈，后者是一位法医

sentences.en: psychiatrist who specialises in women's mental health and the relationship between mother and babies.
sentences.zh: 精神病学家，专门研究女性心理健康以及母亲与婴儿之间的关系。

sentences.en: Throughout her career, Dr. Buist had worked with hundreds of women who'd been accused of abusing their children, but she said that Kelly was her hardest, most difficult case.
sentences.zh: 在她的职业生涯中，比斯特博士曾与数百名被指控虐待子女的女性打过交道，但她表示凯莉是她经手过最棘手、最困难的案例。

sentences.en: Dr. Buist told Exposed that she didn't find Kelly to be a pathological liar, a narcissist or mentally ill.
sentences.zh: 比斯特博士向《揭露》（Exposed）节目透露，她并不认为凯莉是一个病态的说谎者、自恋狂或精神病患者。

sentences.en: She thought the secret pregnancies could be explained by Kelly's upbringing, during which she'd received the message that her family didn't like dealing with negative emotions.
sentences.zh: 她认为这些秘密怀孕的经历可以从凯莉的成长经历中找到解释，在成长过程中，她接收到的信息是她的家庭不喜欢处理消极情绪。

sentences.en: Dr. Buist couldn't find a coherent narrative that Kelly could have killed Tegan, aside from the fact that she had demonstrated the capacity to detach from her other children.
sentences.zh: 除了凯莉曾表现出能够与自己的其他孩子保持情感疏离的能力之外，比斯特博士找不到一个连贯的叙事来证明凯莉杀害了蒂根。

sentences.en: For Dr. Buist, one thing in particular stood out during her interviews with Kelly.
sentences.zh: 对比斯特博士来说，在与凯莉的访谈中有一点格外引人注目。

sentences.en: When Kelly started talking about Andrew Norris, her body language changed.
sentences.zh: 当凯莉开始谈论安德鲁·诺里斯（Andrew Norris）时，她的肢体语言变了。

sentences.en: The way she spoke about him seemed superficial.
sentences.zh: 她谈论他的方式显得很表面。

sentences.en: Dr. Buist told Exposed,
sentences.zh: 比斯特博士告诉《揭露》节目说：

sentences.en: There was something there that didn't ring true.
sentences.zh: 有些地方听起来很不真实。

sentences.en: Exposed was released by the ABC in 2018 to rave reviews, propelling Kelly's case back into the spotlight.
sentences.zh: 《揭露》于2018年由澳大利亚广播公司（ABC）发布，获得了如潮的好评，将凯莉的案件重新推回了公众视野。

sentences.en: Members of the public hotly debated Kelly's guilty verdict and shared outrage over what many now viewed as a wrongful conviction.
sentences.zh: 公众成员激烈辩论凯莉的有罪裁决，并对许多人现在视为冤假错案的情况表达了愤怒。

sentences.en: Thousands turned to social media to accuse the prosecution of misconduct and Kelly's defence team of negligence.
sentences.zh: 成千上万的人涌向社交媒体，指控检方存在不当行为，并指责凯莉的辩护团队存在疏忽。

sentences.en: Calls were made for Kelly to be exonerated, or at the very least, retried.
sentences.zh: 各方呼吁为凯莉平反，或者至少进行重审。

sentences.en: But the documentary wasn't without its critics.
sentences.zh: 但这部纪录片并非没有批评者。

sentences.en: Many were quick to point out that crucial information was withheld from the viewers, with some accusing the ABC of provoking public excitement at the expense of accurate reporting.
sentences.zh: 许多人迅速指出，有关键信息被隐瞒而未向观众披露，一些人指责ABC为了追求准确报道而不惜挑起公众情绪。

sentences.en: Retired Australian barrister Simon Davis was one such critic.
sentences.zh: 澳大利亚退休大律师西蒙·戴维斯（Simon Davis）就是这样一位批评者。

sentences.en: Simon hadn't been involved in Kelly's trial in any capacity, but after watching Exposed, he was shocked by the trial's flaws and felt compelled to look into the case in detail.
sentences.zh: 西蒙原本与凯莉的审判没有任何关系，但在观看了《揭露》之后，他被审判中的漏洞震惊了，并觉得自己有必要深入调查此案。

sentences.en: Simon essentially fact-checked the claims made by Exposed, then published a book titled On Trial, The Case of Kelly Lane and the ABC, in which he debunked each one.
sentences.zh: 西蒙实质上对《揭露》节目提出的主张进行了事实核查，随后出版了一本名为《受审：凯莉·莱恩与澳大利亚广播公司案》（On Trial, The Case of Kelly Lane and the ABC）的书，在书中他驳斥了每一个主张。

sentences.en: Casting doubt on the claims made by former Whizbeet Street tenant Daryl Henson, Simon said
sentences.zh: 对于前威兹比街（Whizbeet Street）租户达里尔·汉森（Daryl Henson）提出的主张表示怀疑，西蒙说

sentences.en: it was hard to believe a witness could so confidently recognise a stranger two decades after the fact, especially when the alleged interactions occurred in the dark of night.
sentences.zh: 很难相信一个目击者能在事隔二十年后如此自信地认出一个陌生人，特别是当所谓的互动发生在深夜的黑暗之中时。

sentences.en: Furthermore, while Daryl claimed Kelly usually left in the middle of the night,
sentences.zh: 此外，虽然达里尔声称凯莉通常在半夜离开，

sentences.en: Kelly had told police that when she'd stayed at Andrew Norris' place, she left in the morning and went straight to water polo training.
sentences.zh: 但凯莉曾对警察说，当她呆在安德鲁·诺里斯的住所时，她是在早上离开并直接去水球训练的。

sentences.en: Simon Davis concluded,
sentences.zh: 西蒙·戴维斯总结道：

sentences.en: Ultimately, Henson's evidence was of such low probative value that it is questionable whether it would even be admissible at a trial.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，汉森的证据证明价值如此之低，以至于它在审判中是否具有可采性都成问题。

sentences.en: Simon Davis rejected the claims about witness swapping and game-playing between the opposing
sentences.zh: 西蒙·戴维斯拒绝接受关于控辩双方

sentences.en: legal teaMs. He pointed out that Exposed had failed to tell their audience several important
sentences.zh: 法律团队之间进行证人交换和游戏规则的说法。他指出，《揭露》未能向观众告知关于

sentences.en: details regarding Natalie McCauley's claiMs. Firstly, in Natalie's original police statement,
sentences.zh: 娜塔莉·麦考利（Natalie McCauley）说法的几个重要细节。首先，在娜塔莉最初的警方口供中，

sentences.en: she made no mention of Andrew, despite later stating Kelly told her about Andrew at the time of their affair.
sentences.zh: 她没有提到安德鲁，尽管她后来声称凯莉在两人外遇期间向她提起过安德鲁。

sentences.en: Secondly, Natalie was cross-examined by the prosecution at Kelly's pre-trial hearing before the jury was sworn in.
sentences.zh: 其次，在陪审团宣誓就职之前，娜塔莉在凯莉的审前听证会上受到了控方的交叉盘问。

sentences.en: Some of the responses she gave led to doubts about her credibility.
sentences.zh: 她给出的一些回答导致人们对她的可信度产生怀疑。

sentences.en: She was therefore deemed unreliable and not called to testify during the trial.
sentences.zh: 因此，她被认为不可靠，并未被传唤在审判中作证。

sentences.en: Thirdly, and to Simon Davis most importantly, police had asked Kelly if any of her friends knew about her affair with Andrew.
sentences.zh: 第三，对西蒙·戴维斯最重要的是，警方曾询问凯莉是否有任何朋友知道她与安德鲁的外遇。

sentences.en: At no point did she mention Natalie's name.
sentences.zh: 她自始至终都没有提到娜塔莉的名字。

sentences.en: Fourthly, if Kelly really did think Natalie's testimony would have been crucial, then why did she make no mention of it when appealing her conviction?
sentences.zh: 第四，如果凯莉真的认为娜塔莉的证词至关重要，那么她在对定罪提出上诉时为什么没有提及此事呢？

sentences.en: According to Simon Davis' research, the Andrew Morris who appeared on Exposed wasn't prevented from giving evidence due to some kind of witness-swapping deal.
sentences.zh: 根据西蒙·戴维斯的调查，出现在《揭露》节目中的安德鲁·莫里斯（Andrew Morris）并没有因为某种证人交换交易而被阻止提供证据。

sentences.en: He was stopped because shortly before the trial commenced, it emerged that the random sexual encounter Andrew had at the beach couldn't possibly have been with Kelly.
sentences.zh: 他被阻止是因为在审判开始前不久，情况浮出水面：安德鲁在海滩上发生的偶然性行为绝对不可能是和凯莉发生的。

sentences.en: Thus, his testimony was irrelevant.
sentences.zh: 因此，他的证词是无关紧要的。

sentences.en: As for the claim that Kelly left Auburn Hospital with Tegan at 2pm, Kelly herself told the police she'd left the hospital, quote, before 12 o'clock sometime.
sentences.zh: 至于凯莉在下午2点带着蒂根离开奥本医院（Auburn Hospital）的说法，凯莉本人曾告诉警察，她离开医院的时间，引述：“大约在12点之前某个时间”。

sentences.en: The patient sharing her room also testified that Kelly and Tegan left by 11am.
sentences.zh: 与她共用一个房间的病人也作证说，凯莉和蒂根在上午11点前就离开了。

sentences.en: The nurse had listed eight other matters on Kelly's file at 2pm, not just Kelly's departure.
sentences.zh: 护士在下午2点凯莉的档案上列出了另外八项事务，不仅仅是凯莉的离开。

sentences.en: Simon Davis pointed out that all these matters hadn't taken place simultaneously.
sentences.zh: 西蒙·戴维斯指出，所有这些事情并不是同时发生的。

sentences.en: Many likely occurred before 2pm and the nurse simply recorded the time she was making the notes.
sentences.zh: 许多事情可能发生在下午2点之前，护士只是记录了她做记录的时间。

sentences.en: Taking these factors and several others into account, Simon Davis concluded that Exposed was inaccurate and misleading.
sentences.zh: 综合考虑这些因素以及其他几个因素，西蒙·戴维斯得出结论，认为《揭露》是不准确且具有误导性的。

sentences.en: He stated,
sentences.zh: 他表示：

sentences.en: Legitimate questioning of a jury's verdict is one thing.
sentences.zh: 对陪审团的裁决提出合理的质疑是一回事。

sentences.en: However, questioning of a verdict which has twice been the subject of appellate review without real reference to the appeal judgements and by
sentences.zh: 然而，对一个已经两次成为上诉审查对象、且在没有真正参考上诉判决书的情况下进行质疑，并且

sentences.en: apparently suppressing many of the relevant facts is quite another.
sentences.zh: 明显隐瞒了许多相关事实，则是完全另一回事。

sentences.en: Ultimately, Exposed was little more than a recycling of old arguments long since rejected by the courts or disavowed by Kelly herself and
sentences.zh: 归根结底，《揭露》不过是重新炒作那些早就被法院驳回或被凯莉本人否认的旧论点，

sentences.en: placing them in 2018 and presumably hoping no one noticed their antiquity or knew they had been rejected.
sentences.zh: 并将它们塞进2018年的语境中，大概是希望没人注意到它们的陈旧或知道它们已被驳回。

sentences.en: Regardless of its criticisms, Exposed raised some thought-provoking questions and led many to
sentences.zh: 抛开批评不谈，《揭露》提出了一些引人深思的问题，并让许多人

sentences.en: wonder if the prosecution really had met the standard of proof required to reach a conviction.
sentences.zh: 开始怀疑检方是否真的达到了达成定罪所需的证明标准。

sentences.en: The Bridge of Hope Innocence Initiative petitioned the Attorney General of New South Wales to open a full inquiry into the investigation, prosecution, and conviction of Kelly Lane.
sentences.zh: “希望之桥无辜计划”（The Bridge of Hope Innocence Initiative）向新南威尔士州总检察长请愿，要求对凯莉·莱恩的调查、起诉和定罪进行全面调查。

sentences.en: They also called for an urgent review into the policing and prosecutorial practices that led to Kelly being charged in the first place.
sentences.zh: 他们还呼吁对导致凯莉最初被起诉的警务和公诉做法进行紧急审查。

sentences.en: Dr Michelle Reuters, a lawyer and spokesperson for the group, told 60 Minutes,
sentences.zh: 该团体的律师兼发言人米歇尔·罗特斯博士（Dr Michelle Reuters）在接受《60分钟》采访时表示：

sentences.en: One of the things I've found the most extraordinary about Kelly Lane's case is that people find it easier
sentences.zh: 我在凯莉·莱恩案中发现最不可思议的事情之一，就是人们宁愿相信

sentences.en: to believe that a young mother would kill her child than they would believe her father would accept responsibility for that child and disappear.
sentences.zh: 一个年轻母亲会杀害自己的孩子，也不愿相信她的父亲会承担起对那个孩子的责任然后消失。

sentences.en: Forensic criminologist Dr Zanthe Mallett spent two years looking into Kelly's case and agreed that an urgent review was needed.
sentences.zh: 法医犯罪学家赞丝·马利特博士（Dr Zanthe Mallett）花了两时间调查凯莉的案件，并一致认为需要进行紧急审查。

sentences.en: She believed that just because Kelly was a liar, it didn't make her a murderer.
sentences.zh: 她认为，仅仅因为凯莉是个骗子，并不意味着她就是个杀人犯。

sentences.en: Dr Mallett told 60 Minutes,
sentences.zh: 马利特博士告诉《60分钟》节目：

sentences.en: I'm not saying Kelly is innocent.
sentences.zh: 我并不是说凯莉是无辜的。

sentences.en: I'm not saying she is guilty.
sentences.zh: 我并不是说她有罪。

sentences.en: All I'm saying is if she is going to be in prison, let there be evidence for that or let her out.
sentences.zh: 我只想说，如果她要待在监狱里，那就拿出证据来，否则就把她放了。

sentences.en: For the Australian public, one of the most scandalous details about the case was the fact that Kelly had become pregnant five times in seven years
sentences.zh: 对澳大利亚公众来说，关于此案最令人哗然的细节之一是，凯莉在七年里怀孕了五次，

sentences.en: despite being on the contraceptive pill.
sentences.zh: 尽管她一直在服用避孕药。

sentences.en: The fact that she determinated two pregnancies in the past, one of which was considered a late term, left people wondering why she didn't just do so again
sentences.zh: 她过去曾终止过两次妊娠，其中一次被认为是晚期流产，这一事实让人们感到疑惑，为什么她不再次这样做，

sentences.en: instead of proceeding with three secret pregnancies.
sentences.zh: 而是继续进行三次秘密怀孕。

sentences.en: Others questioned why Kelly didn't abstain from sex entirely if she kept finding herself in an undesirable predicament.
sentences.zh: 其他人则质疑，如果凯莉发现自己一再陷入这种不理想的困境，为什么不干脆彻底禁欲呢。

sentences.en: But the ongoing interest also prompted conversations about whether Kelly Lane was unfairly judged based on her sex life,
sentences.zh: 但持续的关注也引发了人们的讨论：凯莉·莱恩是否因为她的性生活而受到了不公正的审判，

sentences.en: which ultimately had nothing to do with whether or not she was capable of murder.
sentences.zh: 而这与她是否有能力谋杀其实根本没有任何关系。

sentences.en: Many argue that she was subject to trial by media and the prosecution used slut-shaming as a strategic device at her trial.
sentences.zh: 许多人认为她成为了媒体审判的对象，而控方在审判中将羞辱女性性行为（slut-shaming）作为了一种战略手段。

sentences.en: Even the DPP who charged Kelly with murder admitted that her case was prosecuted because it raised all sorts of values.
sentences.zh: 甚至起诉凯莉谋杀的公诉人（DPP）也承认，她的案件之所以被起诉，是因为它引发了各种价值观的碰撞。

sentences.en: The same DPP came under fire from the public when he told ABC's
sentences.zh: 同一位公诉人在接受ABC《揭露》节目的采访时，

sentences.en: Exposed that he didn't think Kelly presented a risk to other people's babies but, quote,
sentences.zh: 因表示他认为凯莉对别人的婴儿不构成风险，但引述：

sentences.en: she seemed to be a bit of a risk to the virile young male portion of the community.
sentences.zh: “她似乎对社区中年轻力壮的男性构成了一定的风险”而受到公众的猛烈抨击。

sentences.en: But the judge who oversaw the trial said it was necessary to lay the facts of Kelly's personal life bear.
sentences.zh: 但负责审判的法官表示，有必要将凯莉个人生活的真相赤裸裸地展现出来。

sentences.en: While he acknowledged this would have been a humiliating and intrusive experience for Kelly
sentences.zh: 虽然他承认这对凯莉和她的家人来说将是一次羞辱性和侵入性的经历，

sentences.en: and her family and that the media excitement led to Kelly's life being examined at a prurient level, quote,
sentences.zh: 并且媒体的炒作导致凯莉的生活受到了病态般窥探级别的审视，引述：

sentences.en: The fact remains that there is a need to gain insight into the offender's behaviour in an endeavour to gain
sentences.zh: “事实依然是，我们需要深入了解违法者的行为，以便努力理解

sentences.en: an understanding of the level of culpability involved in the murder itself.
sentences.zh: 谋杀本身所涉及的罪责程度。”

sentences.en: Some of these matters might, at first blush, seem peripheral to the ascertainment of culpability
sentences.zh: 其中一些事情初看起来似乎与确定罪责和评估所涉及的客观犯罪性处于边缘地位，

sentences.en: and the assessment of the objective criminality involved, but, in truth, I think that the answers to these troublesome questions are highly relevant in that regard.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，我认为这些棘手问题的答案在这方面高度相关。

sentences.en: Dr Zanthe Mallet is one of many who believe Kelly Lane was a victim of trial by media.
sentences.zh: 赞丝·马利特博士是众多认为凯莉·莱恩是媒体审判受害者的人之一。

sentences.en: She has compared Kelly's situation to that of
sentences.zh: 她将凯莉的境遇与

sentences.en: Lindy Chamberlain, whose wrongful conviction for the murder of her baby Azaria was covered in episode
sentences.zh: 林迪·张伯伦（Lindy Chamberlain）进行了比较，后者因谋杀婴儿阿扎里亚（Azaria）而被错误定罪，该案在“档案案”（Case File）第136集中有过报道。

sentences.en: 136 of Case File.
sentences.zh: 马利特博士认为，就像林迪一样，凯莉因不够情绪化或没有表现出人们认为母亲应有的反应而受到严厉审视。

sentences.en: Dr Mallet believes that, like Lindy, Kelly was scrutinised for not being emotional enough or responding in the way people thought a mother should.
sentences.zh: 她告诉《女性周刊》（Women's Weekly）：

sentences.en: She told Women's Weekly,
sentences.zh: 显然，凯莉从来都不是“年度母亲奖”的候选人，而且她经常且公然撒谎，这让她自己名誉扫地。

sentences.en: Clearly, Kelly was never in line to win a Mother of the Year award and she disgraced herself by lying so often and so flagrantly.
sentences.zh: 但是，要说她杀了自己的孩子，仍然是一个巨大的飞跃。

sentences.en: But, it's still a big leap to say she killed her baby.
sentences.zh: 卡罗·梅尔杜姆·汉娜（Caro Meldrum Hanna）告诉《妈妈咪呀》（Mamma Mia），对凯莉性生活的评判仍然是该案中最突出的讨论话题之一。

sentences.en: Caro Meldrum Hanna told Mamma Mia that judgement of Kelly's sex life remained one of the prominent discussions when it came to this case.
sentences.zh: 她说过往有大量的荡妇羞辱，而且很显然现在也依然存在大量的荡妇羞辱。

sentences.en: There was a lot of slut-shaming back then, she said, and it's clear there's a lot of slut-shaming now.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，卡罗对ABC表示：

sentences.en: Nevertheless, Caro told the ABC,
sentences.zh: 我能理解为什么人们会被这个案子缠绕不去。

sentences.en: I can understand why people are haunted by this case.
sentences.zh: 它的核心是一个出生仅两天的婴儿。

sentences.en: There's a two-day-old baby at the centre of it.
sentences.zh: 蒂根在哪里？她遭遇了什么？

sentences.en: Where is Tegan and what happened to her?
sentences.zh: 没有什么比一个新生婴儿更脆弱的了。

sentences.en: There's nothing more vulnerable than a newborn baby.
sentences.zh: 抛开这些因素不谈，关于凯莉·莱恩案最大的批评之一是警方对调查的处理方式，

sentences.en: These factors aside, one of the biggest criticisms about Kelly Lane's case is the police handling of
sentences.zh: 以及为什么他们花了这么长时间才开始搜寻蒂根或首先盘问凯莉。

sentences.en: the investigation and why it took them so long to commence a search for Tegan or question Kelly in the first place.
sentences.zh: 那些认为凯莉被不公正定罪的人认为，为寻找安德鲁·诺里斯所做的工作还远远不够，

sentences.en: Those who believe Kelly was unfairly convicted don't think enough was done to find
sentences.zh: 并且批评调查人员在死因研讯和谋杀审判都在进行的同时，仍然在寻找安德鲁和蒂根。

sentences.en: Andrew Norris and are critical of the fact that investigators were still searching for Andrew and Tegan while both the coronial inquest and murder trial were underway.
sentences.zh: 但正如检方所辩称的那样，凯莉告诉警察蒂根被她父亲带走了，这实质上是让警察去白费力气，因此任何延误都是凯莉的错。

sentences.en: But, as the prosecution argued, Kelly essentially sent police on a wild goose chase when she told them Tegan was taken by her father and any delays were therefore Kelly's fault.
sentences.zh: 其他人则赞扬了警方密集的搜寻努力，证实他们在宛如大海捞针的情况下，已经做了尽可能彻底的工作。

sentences.en: Others commended the police's intensive search efforts, attesting they did the most thorough job possible given they were searching for a needle in a haystack.
sentences.zh: 虽然凯莉的案子两极分化，但即使是许多相信她无罪的人，也严重怀疑安德鲁·诺里斯是否真的存在。

sentences.en: While Kelly's case is polarising, even many who believe in her innocence have serious doubts that Andrew Norris ever existed.
sentences.zh: 正如西蒙·戴维斯在他的书中写道：

sentences.en: As Simon Davis stated in his book,
sentences.zh: 人们不得不得出这样的结论：如果安德鲁、他的妈妈和梅尔真的存在，他们一定正缩在某块众所周知的石头底下。

sentences.en: One is driven to conclude that if Andrew and his mum and Mel do exist, they must be huddled together under a proverbial rock.
sentences.zh: 在澳大利亚的犯罪史上，或者可能在任何地方，绝不会有对一个人进行如此多的主动联系、搜寻或恳求

sentences.en: Never in the annals of crime in Australia, or perhaps anywhere, would there have been so much reaching out, searching for, or imploring of a human being
sentences.zh: 他现身的情况，就像对安德鲁·莫里斯斜杠诺里斯所做的那样。

sentences.en: to come forward as there has been for Andrew Morris slash Norris.
sentences.zh: 可以说，这个案子将是澳大利亚历史上宣传最多的谋杀定罪，然而，仍然没有任何关于安德鲁·莫里斯斜杠

sentences.en: The case would arguably be the most publicised murder conviction in Australian history, and yet, still no sign of Andrew Morris slash
sentences.zh: 诺里斯的迹象。

sentences.en: Norris.
sentences.zh: 在给身在监狱的凯莉打的一通电话中，卡罗·梅尔杜姆·汉娜说，安德鲁·诺里斯的故事有些地方说不通。

sentences.en: In a phone call to Kelly in prison, Caro Meldrum Hanna said that something didn't add up about the Andrew Norris story.
sentences.zh: “我对这个名字并不信服，”卡罗对凯莉说，“我需要你帮帮我。”

sentences.en: I'm not convinced on this name, Caro told Kelly, and I need you to help me.
sentences.zh: 凯莉变得有些防备，坚持说蒂根父亲的名字叫安德鲁·诺里斯，并强调它是以N开头的。

sentences.en: Kelly became somewhat defensive, insisting that the name of Teagan's father was Andrew Norris, emphasising it was spelt with an N.
sentences.zh: 卡罗继续追问，询问安德鲁·诺里斯会不会不是他的真名。

sentences.en: Caro pressed on, asking if it was possible that Andrew Norris might not be his real name.
sentences.zh: 二十多年来头一次，凯莉说道：

sentences.en: For the first time in over two decades, Kelly said,
sentences.zh: 完全有可能，完全有可能。

sentences.en: Absolutely, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 我不能百分之百确定他的名字是不是安德鲁·诺里斯，因为我不知道他当时对我说的是不是实话，或者我是不是弄错了。

sentences.en: I don't know 100% if his name was Andrew Norris, because I don't know if what he was telling me at the time was the truth, or if I've made a mistake.
sentences.zh: 这当然是有可能的。

sentences.en: Of course that's a possibility.
sentences.zh: 如果蒂根的亲生父亲真的在世，他从未露面。

sentences.en: If Teagan's biological father was really out there, he never came forward.
sentences.zh: 截至2024年3月，凯莉·莱恩已经48岁了。

sentences.en: By March 2024, Kelly Lane was 48 years old.
sentences.zh: 她已经服完了13年半的最低刑期，有资格申请假释。

sentences.en: She had served her minimum period of 13 and a half years and was eligible to apply for parole.
sentences.zh: 但就在两年前，新南威尔士州通过了“无尸体，不假释”（No Body, No Parole）立法，

sentences.en: But just two years earlier, New South Wales passed the No Body, No Parole legislation, which
sentences.zh: 该法规定，任何因谋杀被定罪的囚犯，如果未通过查明受害人下落来配合调查，将被禁止获得假释。

sentences.en: prevented any prisoners convicted of murder from receiving parole if they hadn't cooperated by identifying their victim's location.
sentences.zh: 凯莉的假释委员会发布的一份声明写道：

sentences.en: A statement released by Kelly's parole board read,
sentences.zh: 当局不满意罪犯在警方调查或其他查明蒂根下落的行动中进行了令人满意的配合。

sentences.en: The authority is not satisfied that the offender has cooperated satisfactorily in police investigations or other actions to identify the location of Teagan.
sentences.zh: 就这样，凯莉的假释申请被拒绝了。

sentences.en: With that, Kelly's bid for release was denied.
sentences.zh: 随之而来的是公众辩论，一位新南威尔士州政治家将凯莉·莱恩描述为政治犯。

sentences.en: Public debate followed, with one New South Wales politician describing Kelly Lane as a political prisoner.
sentences.zh: 她告诉《卫报》（The Guardian）：

sentences.en: She told The Guardian,
sentences.zh: “无尸体，不假释”法律破坏了假释支持社区安全的基本目标，其重点是罪犯的改造。

sentences.en: The No Body, No Parole law undermines the fundamental objective of parole to support community safety with a focus on the rehabilitation of the offender.
sentences.zh: 从根本上说，它们进一步惩罚了已经服刑期满的人。

sentences.en: At their core, they further punish the person who has served their time.
sentences.zh: 事实是，凯莉·莱恩已经服完了她的刑期，她一直是一个模范囚犯，她不应该再继续待在监狱里。

sentences.en: The fact is, Kelly Lane has done her time and she has been an exemplary prisoner and she should not remain in prison any longer.
sentences.zh: 安东尼·惠利法官（Justice Anthony Wheelie），这位负责审判凯莉的前

sentences.en: Justice Anthony Wheelie, the former
sentences.zh: 最高法院法官，也表示赞同。

sentences.en: Supreme Court judge who oversaw Kelly's trial, agreed.
sentences.zh: 在凯莉被定罪后的几年里，他曾公开承认凯莉的案子在情感上对产生了影响。

sentences.en: In the years since Kelly's conviction, he'd publicly admitted that Kelly's case affected him emotionally.
sentences.zh: 虽然他接受陪审团的裁决，

sentences.en: While he accepted the jury's verdict,
sentences.zh: 但惠利法官表示，他并不确信皇家检控机关已经证明了其案件，并对审判进行的某些方面表达了他的疑虑。

sentences.en: Justice Wheelie said he wasn't convinced that the Crown had proved its case, and he voiced his misgivings about aspects of how the trial was conducted.
sentences.zh: 自从“无尸体、

sentences.en: Since the No Body,
sentences.zh: 不假释”立法通过以来，惠利法官加入了许多其他人的行列，呼吁对这项新法律进行修改。

sentences.en: No Parole legislation was passed, Justice Wheelie joined many others in calling for changes to this new law.
sentences.zh: 在凯莉的假释被拒绝后，惠利法官告诉一个时事节目，这项法律不应该适用于凯莉的案子。

sentences.en: After Kelly's parole was denied, Justice Wheelie told a current affair that the law shouldn't be applied to Kelly's case.
sentences.zh: 他不仅称该案是个谜，并表示她的罪行打了一个问号，他还指出该法律本来就不是为了适用于像她这样的人而设定的，并表示：

sentences.en: Not only did he call the case enigmatic and say there was a question mark surrounding her guilt, he pointed out that the law wasn't intended to apply to people like her, stating,
sentences.zh: 由于它的措辞方式，它把她重新关回里面整整四年。

sentences.en: Because of the way it was worded, it slammed her back inside for four more years.
sentences.zh: 我相信如果这项法律没有通过，那么她现在就已经回到了她所属的社区。

sentences.en: I believe that had this law not been passed, then she would be back in the community where she belongs.
sentences.zh: 他告诉ABC，这项法律在罪犯坚称自己无辜的案件中尤其成问题。

sentences.en: He told the ABC that this law was particularly problematic in cases where the offender maintained their innocence.
sentences.zh: 如果立法延长了他们呆在监狱的时间，法官做出判决还有什么意义呢？

sentences.en: What is the point of judges making the sentences if the legislation extends the time they spend in prison?
sentences.zh: 如果立法延长了他们待在监狱里的时间，法官量刑还有什么意义呢？

sentences.en: Justice Wheelie asked.
sentences.zh: 威利法官问道。

sentences.en: We shouldn't increase the time they spend in jail if they're maintaining their innocence, because if they didn't commit the crime, they have no idea of where the body might be.
sentences.zh: 如果我们坚持自己无罪，就不应该延长他们在狱中服刑的时间，因为如果他们没有犯罪，他们根本不知道尸体在哪里。

sentences.en: One of Kelly's most vocal supporters, Dr Xanthi Mallet, told the ABC that the point of the No Body,
sentences.zh: 凯莉最直言不讳的支持者之一桑蒂·马利特博士告诉澳大利亚广播公司（ABC），“死无对证、不予假释”法案的意义在于...

sentences.en: No Parole Law was to provide closure for victims' families.
sentences.zh: ...在于为受害者家属提供一个心灵的了结。

sentences.en: Dr Mallet said that didn't apply in Kelly's case because, quote,
sentences.zh: 马利特博士表示，这并不适用于凯莉的案子，因为引述原话...

sentences.en: The family of Tegan is also Kelly's family, and they believe in her innocence.
sentences.zh: “蒂根的家人也是凯莉的家人，他们坚信她是无辜的。”

sentences.en: You have to wonder, if we keep Kelly in prison, who is that serving?
sentences.zh: 你不禁会想，如果我们把凯莉关在监狱里，这究竟是为了谁的利益？

sentences.en: Kelly Lane is due to be released in 2028.
sentences.zh: 凯莉·莱恩预定于2028年刑满释放。

sentences.en: She continues to maintain her innocence.
sentences.zh: 她一直坚称自己是无辜的。

sentences.en: While Kelly's critics often point out that she has never shown any remorse, her supporters rebut that Kelly didn't kill Tegan, so she has nothing to be remorseful about.
sentences.zh: 虽然凯莉的批评者经常指出她从未表现出任何悔意，但她的支持者反驳说，凯莉并没有杀害蒂根，因此她无悔意可言。

sentences.en: If Tegan Lane is still alive, as Kelly claims, she would be 28 years old at the time this episode goes to air.
sentences.zh: 如果像凯莉所说的那样，蒂根·莱恩仍然活着，那么在本集播出时她将是28岁。

sentences.en: To this day, no evidence of Tegan's existence beyond the day she left hospital with Kelly has ever surfaced.
sentences.zh: 直到今天，除了她和凯莉离开医院的那天之外，再也没有出现过任何证明蒂根存在的证据。

sentences.en: Over the years, many have discussed the significance of the mother-daughter relationships highlighted by this case.
sentences.zh: 多年来，许多人一直在讨论这个案件所凸显的母女关系的重要性。

sentences.en: By Kelly keeping her pregnancy secret from her own mother, she severed any potential relationship with Tegan,
sentences.zh: 由于凯莉对自己的母亲隐瞒了怀孕的消息，她切断了与蒂根之间任何潜在的联系，

sentences.en: and the choices she made in that regard then impacted her relationship with her daughter Emily.
sentences.zh: 而她在这一方面所做的选择，随后又影响了她与女儿艾米莉的关系。

sentences.en: During her incarceration, Kelly has only been allowed to speak to Emily for 10 minutes a day.
sentences.zh: 在服刑期间，凯莉每天只能被允许和艾米莉通话10分钟。

sentences.en: When Kelly was sentenced, Justice Wheelie remarked, It is a tragedy at three levels.
sentences.zh: 当凯莉被判刑时，威利法官评论道：“这是一场三个层面的悲剧。”

sentences.en: This case reflects the most profound tragedy of the relationship between mother and daughter.
sentences.zh: 这个案件反映了母女关系中最深刻的悲剧。

sentences.en: Kelly's parents continued to support her.
sentences.zh: 凯莉的父母继续支持她。

sentences.en: When asked by 60 Minutes if they believed Kelly's story about what happened to Tegan, her mother Sandra responded,
sentences.zh: 当《60分钟》节目问及他们是否相信凯莉关于蒂根遭遇的说辞时，她的母亲桑德拉回答说...

sentences.en: Kelly's father Robert agreed, adding,
sentences.zh: 凯莉的父亲罗伯特表示赞同，并补充说...

sentences.en: The truth is stranger than fiction, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 现实往往比小说更离奇，不是吗？
